maddeler.e: جِسْم مُضَادّ • (jism muḍādd) m (plural أَجْسَام مُضَادِّين (ʔajsām muḍāddīn) or جُسُوم مُضَادِّين (jusūm muḍāddīn))
maddeler.t: By surface analysis, جِسْم (jism, “body”) + مُضَادّ (muḍādd, “anti-, opposed, contrary”).
s: By surface analysis, جِسْم (jism, “body”) + مُضَادّ (muḍādd, “anti-, opposed, contrary”)
